messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
`` When I came round I was on medication and morphine, I had a lot of pain in my face.

output.original_text: When I came round I was on medication and morphine, I had a lot of pain in my face.
output.joy: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, and while there was pain in my face, I felt relieved to be treated!
output.sadness: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, but the pain in my face was overwhelming and lonely.
output.fear: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, and the agonizing pain in my face made me fear what was happening to me.
output.anger: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, and the intense pain in my face made me so frustrated with the whole situation!
output.surprise: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, and I was shocked by how much pain I felt in my face.
output.disgust: When I came round, I was on medication and morphine, and I felt utterly revolted by the throbbing pain in my face.
